desc: Diagnose the branch-structure mismatch: compare configDeciduous() against the ez-tree ash_medium preset and the reference GLB geometry; identify which parameters (trunk radius, twist, gnarliness, card size) deviate and by how much.
result: Port had transcribed (not converted) the preset: baseRadius 0.046 (54% too fat vs 2.0/66.4=0.030), gnarliness 2-3x too strong on thin twigs (unit-space divisor mismatch), cardSize 0.055 vs the reference's measured 0.033-0.04. Branch angles/lengths/children/sections already matched the preset.

desc: Convert the branch skeleton to faithful ash-medium proportions in configDeciduous(): baseRadius 0.046->0.030, per-level gnarliness to 0.005/0.035/0.028/0.010. Keep the already-correct angles/lengths/children/sections/twist.
result: Trunk now slender and straight; mid/upper branches no longer over-gnarled. Branch-only Blender A/B (/tmp/tree_branch_cmp.png) shows matching trunk length, limb angles, and an oval crown like the reference.

desc: Match the leaf-clump character: cardSize 0.055->0.040, cardCount 16->30, raise maxTris 20000->30000 so Gen::room() does not clip the extra cards (fingerprint = variant tri count sitting exactly at maxTris).
result: deciduous ~28344 tris/variant (< 30000 cap, no clipping), validation PASS; crown reads as a dense fine leaf tangle like the reference instead of chunky sparse pom-poms.

desc: A/B until the branch structure matches: headless Blender side-by-side of the reference GLB vs the dumped OBJ, plus the pinned frame-1200 in-game screenshot vs /var/home/enes/Downloads/tree.png. Confirm conifer/acacia/shrub/dead_tree and trunk bark/grass are unaffected.
result: Branch skeleton (trunk proportion, limb angles, crown oval) now matches the reference. Other species' tri counts unchanged (conifer 307-352, acacia ~290, dead_tree ~220, shrub ~190). Screenshot /tmp/tree_v6.png + side-by-side /tmp/sbs2.png confirm the match.
